convention: p_right = R @ p_left + t; row arrays: points @ R.T + t
scope: Original local source surfaces only; no MuJoCo calls, no mesh decomposition, no scaling or deformation.

sample_method.distribution: Independent uniform by triangle area, square-root barycentric sampling.
sample_method.target_query: Continuous closed-triangle nearest; full BVH searched except AABB lower-bound pruning by current valid nearest-vertex/triangle upper bound.
sample_method.saved_proof: validation_samples.npz: source face IDs, barycentrics, sampled points, distances, target nearest face IDs, and nearest point witnesses.
sample_method.limitation: Reported maxima are maxima over saved finite area samples; small-area features may be missed and no full-surface Hausdorff bound is claimed.
